# ✅ FINAL VERIFICATION & TERMINATION — DEPLOYMENT LIFECYCLE v1.2.0

# Step 1: Confirm latest log entry in handoff-completion.log
if grep -q "Handoff completed. Deployment lifecycle v1.2.0 officially closed. \[2025-04-05T14:46:12Z\]" /logs/handoff-completion.log; then
    echo "✅ Log entry verified: Correct final message present."
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Expected log entry not found or malformed." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Check for duplicates (ensure only one instance of the final message)
if grep -c "Handoff completed. Deployment lifecycle v1.2.0 officially closed. \[2025-04-05T14:46:12Z\]" /logs/handoff-completion.log; then
    if [ $(grep -c "Handoff completed. Deployment lifecycle v1.2.0 officially closed. \[2025-04-05T14:46:12Z\]" /logs/handoff-completion.log) -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "✅ No duplicate entries detected."

        echo "❌ ERROR: Duplicate final log entry detected." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Final log entry missing entirely." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Step 2: Validate public report via HTTP HEAD request
echo "🔍 Validating public report at https://docs.example.com/reports/v1.2.0/deployment-report-final-v1.2.0.md..."

HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -I https://docs.example.com/reports/v1.2.0/deployment-report-final-v1.2.0.md)

if echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep -q "HTTP/2 200"; then
    echo "✅ HTTP status: 200 OK"
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Expected HTTP/2 200, got non-200 response." >&2
    echo "Response headers:"
    echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE"
    exit 1
fi

if echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "content-type.*text/markdown"; then
    echo "✅ Content-Type: text/markdown confirmed."
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Missing or incorrect content-type." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "strict-transport-security.*max-age=31536000"; then
    echo "✅ HSTS header with max-age=31536000 present."
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: HSTS header missing or invalid." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "etag"; then
    echo "✅ ETag header present."
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: ETag header missing." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "last-modified"; then
    echo "✅ Last-Modified header present."
else
    echo "❌ ERROR: Last-Modified header missing." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Step 3: Append final confirmation to log and terminate gracefully
echo "Deployment lifecycle v1.2.0 has been successfully closed." | tee -a /logs/handoff-completion.log

# Exit with success code
exit 0
